translated_title: Cablebús Line 4 Will Be Ready in December 2027; “It’s a Social Justice Project,” Sheinbaum Says
original_title: Línea 4 del Cablebús estará lista en diciembre de 2027; “es un proyecto de justicia social”: Sheinbaum
author: Iván Evair Saldaña
meta_description: Sheinbaum inspected Cablebús Line 4, a “social justice” project due in December 2027 that will cut the Tlalpan–Ciudad Universitaria commute from two hours to 40 minutes.
image_warnings: Original La Jornada event photo (Luis Castillo) was blocked by Cloudflare; replaced with a high-res CC BY-SA 4.0 Cablebús image from Wikimedia Commons (Luis Alvaz) as an illustrative featured image.
author_link_note: La Jornada author page follows the standard /autores/<byline> pattern but could NOT be verified live (Cloudflare 403).
